The '''IG-110 lightsaber droid''' was created by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] to deal with the growing involvement of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]]s were based heavily on the design of the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]], and proved effective in dealing with the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding Jedi. Their programming was created from thousands of hours of [[Hologram/Legends|holorecordings]] of Jedi in combat. The IG-110 would wield two [[Color/Legends|red]] lightsabers, which used [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|synthetic lightsaber crystals]].<ref name="TCWCG" />
